query: SELECT JSON_VALID(related_entities) AS valid,COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM demo_gkxlumenx_dwd.policy_base_info WHERE is_deleted=0 GROUP BY valid

SELECT SUM(COALESCE(JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(related_entities,'$.enterprise')),0)>0) AS enterprise_nonempty,SUM(COALESCE(JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(related_entities,'$.talent')),0)>0) AS talent_nonempty,SUM(COALESCE(JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(related_entities,'$.research')),0)>0) AS research_nonempty,SUM(COALESCE(JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(related_entities,'$.org')),0)>0) AS org_nonempty,SUM(COALESCE(JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(related_entities,'$.industry')),0)>0) AS industry_nonempty,SUM(COALESCE(JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(related_entities,'$.service')),0)>0) AS service_nonempty FROM demo_gkxlumenx_dwd.policy_base_info WHERE is_deleted=0 AND JSON_VALID(related_entities)=1
SELECT JSON_KEYS(related_entities) AS keys_present,COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM demo_gkxlumenx_dwd.policy_base_info WHERE is_deleted=0 AND JSON_VALID(related_entities)=1 GROUP BY keys_present

SELECT JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(related_entities,'$.org[0]')) AS first_org_type,COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM demo_gkxlumenx_dwd.policy_base_info WHERE is_deleted=0 AND JSON_VALID(related_entities)=1 GROUP BY first_org_type
SELECT source,COUNT(*) AS cnt,MIN(create_time) AS first_created,MAX(update_time) AS last_updated FROM demo_gkxlumenx_dwd.policy_base_info WHERE is_deleted=0 GROUP BY source
